The structure of Mn24Fe20N20 (Mn3Fe2N2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 194), with 64 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Fe and Mn centers predominantly in octahedral environments with six N neighbors, with Fe–N distances of 1.94–2.00 Å and Mn–N distances of 2.01–2.22 Å. N centers adopt octahedral environments with mixed Fe and Mn neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 64 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Fe and Mn octahedra, plus edge-sharing among like octahedra.
